display_name: Caregiver Income Impact & Lost Earnings Estimator
description: Financial cost of unpaid caregiving: direct income loss during the care period, the retirement savings gap from missed 401(k) contributions plus their lost compounding, the cumulative cost of a post-care career setback, and a flagged Social Security reduction estimate, in integer USD cents. The SSA contribution and benefit base and the SSA average annual benefit are selected from a pinned vintage table by an explicit as_of date (the node reads no clock). Ported from ApexLogics display_number #117 (117-caregiver-income-impact, al_id AL-124, CC BY 4.0); DIFFERS-D1..D5 in the porting payload, three modelling constants UNGROUNDED.
deferred_reason: New gpu:false node, art-761-caregiver-income-impact, built 2026-10-20 (APEX-PORT-117-LAND-1). Float arithmetic over pinned SSA vintage constants with no digest inside compute(); expected FAST on GPU-CYCLE-PREFLIGHT-1 static pre-screen (no transcendentals beyond Math.pow in the fixed annuity formula, no iteration bound taken from policy_parameters, no in-guest signature or hash verification). standards_basis is not_applicable: the node implements no published standard or regulation - its premises are the Apex page's own model plus the pinned SSA vintages (C1/C2), ported with UNGROUNDED flags on the three modelling constants per the APEXPORT-117 payload (DIFFERS D1-D5, CITES U-flags).
